content_of_post_to_comment: Nordic countries have low state capacity if capacity is understood as the state’s ability to do things. They have minor militaries, non-existent international influence, small public research agendas, no space program, irrelevant regulatory bodies… the list goes on. They have the capacity of a high functioning city; not a state. The only thing they are truly world class at is tunneling. I’d be very careful generalizing what works for states that don’t do anything to the US which does everything.
